StateTree.Comment: Dead state tree for every class: AiPlayerbot.StateTree.Dead.Default

Task.Comment: where the body is: released, corpseLocation, corpseFar, onCorpseFar

Task.name: Corpse Run
Task.Comment: movement goal (MovementGoal_GlobalTask): the ghost runs back to its body (a body in a dungeon through its portal, where the core resurrects the ghost; outdoors the Reaction tree reclaims the body once in reach)

State.name: Release Spirit
State.Comment: the spirit goes to the graveyard (outside the dungeon after a death inside one); a resurrection offered to the ghost is still accepted by the Reaction tree (Accept Resurrection)

Task.Comment: at the body (the Reaction tree reclaims it) or waiting: selects again every second
